name: s81dv_idxtxn32t-h-COMMIT
purpose: TX structural symmetric clock spine h

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsdv_idx_tx_n32 #(.V(276), .IK(4), .EK(5), .UID(92), .D(8192), .IB(64), .SRAM_MACRO(1), .MUT(0), .RDL(1), .WDL(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/idx/dsdv_idx_tree.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/idx/dsdv_idx_l20s.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81dv_idxtxn32t/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81dv_idxtxn32t/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81dv_idxtxn32t --out {RUN}/record/views/dsdv_idx_tx_n32 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: s81dv_idxtxn32t (STW-S81c-COLLA 10-22, TX h NEEDS_RTL TT -219 / FF -27 / DRC 3): RDL=1 score-store rd_out captured in a kept register at each bank's pins (+1 lookup edge, consumer pipe LP 2->3), WDL=1 write port landed per bank (+1 write edge); outline 626.4x561.6 (never shrink). Ports identical; edges priced in MU.S81.CAL.
